settings.subtitle: Cooper is the brand Calgary daily-drivers reach for when they want premium-adjacent quality at a friendlier price. We stock the Endeavor A/S, Endeavor Plus, Traction Command (3PMSF all-weather), Evolution Winter, and Discoverer H/T3 at 111 42 Ave SW.
settings.intro_heading: Why we recommend Cooper in Calgary
settings.intro_richtext:
Cooper has been making tires in Akron, Ohio since 1914. Now owned by Goodyear, Cooper sits in a sweet spot for Calgary drivers — premium-adjacent quality and warranty service, friendlier price than the top-tier brands.

The Traction Command is the Cooper all-weather (3PMSF rated) — same idea as Michelin CrossClimate2 or Toyo Celsius II, at a noticeably better price. Meets Alberta's winter-tire law year-round, no seasonal swap needed.

For sedan and crossover commuters, the Endeavor A/S and bigger-vehicle Endeavor Plus are quiet, long-wearing all-seasons that punch above their price. For dedicated winter, the Evolution Winter is studdable — built for Calgary's coldest weeks.

Every Cooper we install gets the same balance, calibrated torque, and TPMS reset as our premium-priced jobs — and we price-match local Calgary competitors. Book installation or call (403) 452-4283.
settings.cta_description: Stocked Cooper sizes installed same-day. Price-matched against any local Calgary competitor on the same model.
settings.faq_1_q: Is Cooper a good tire brand?
settings.faq_1_a: Yes — Cooper has been making tires since 1914 and is owned by Goodyear since 2021. Premium-adjacent quality at a friendlier price than Michelin/Bridgestone. We carry Cooper for Calgary drivers who want long warranty and reliable performance without paying top-tier money.
settings.faq_2_q: What's the best Cooper tire for Calgary year-round?
settings.faq_2_a: The Traction Command — Cooper's 3PMSF-rated all-weather tire. Meets Alberta winter law, so you skip the seasonal swap. Sits between the Endeavor A/S and a dedicated winter in capability — right pick for low-mileage commuters who don't want two sets of tires.
settings.faq_3_q: How much do Cooper tires cost in Calgary?
settings.faq_3_a: Cooper tires at Prince Tires range from $155 to $310 per tire. Endeavor A/S starts around $155 in common 16" sizes; Traction Command around $190; Discoverer H/T3 around $250; Evolution Winter around $210.
settings.faq_4_q: Are Cooper Evolution Winter tires studdable?
settings.faq_4_a: Yes. The Evolution Winter is a studdable winter tire — Prince Tires can install it studless (recommended for most Calgary driving) or studded (for icy rural commutes east of Calgary or in the foothills). Studs require winter-only use; we remove them when you swap to summer tires.
settings.faq_5_q: Endeavor A/S vs Endeavor Plus — which one?
settings.faq_5_a: Endeavor A/S is the standard sedan/crossover version. Endeavor Plus has higher load ratings for bigger vehicles (SUVs, light trucks) and longer treadwear. Same tread design, scaled differently. We stock both in popular Calgary sizes.

settings.calgary_richtext: Cooper is the North American daily-driver brand we recommend for value-conscious sedan and SUV owners. Discoverer AT3 is a balanced all-terrain that doesn't drone on pavement. Discoverer Snow Claw is a quiet winter pick under $200/tire. Endeavor Plus covers the all-season lane for sedans with surprisingly long tread life on Calgary's rough secondary roads.
settings.awards_text: Over 100 years of North American tire manufacturing. Goodyear-owned since 2021.
settings.testimonial_quote: Discoverer AT3 on my Tacoma daily — quiet enough for highway, grippy enough for back roads. Sweet spot for the price.
